How to read this chart

Example

Measurements:
    Toe-in    -4 mm (-0.16 in.)
    Camber    (Right side)    -1°15'
              (Left side)      -45'

Amount to turn adjusting cam (by graduation):
    Right side    (Front cam)    +1.9 (clockwise)
                  (Rear cam)     +0.6 (clockwise)
    Left side     (Front cam)    +0.7 (counterclockwise)
                  (Rear cam)     -0.7 (clockwise)
